title: TAPS — Strong yet Controllable LLM Abstention
description: Against a strong selector, abstention training’s edge comes mostly from answering better, while it fixes coverage. TAPS (train for accuracy, then select post hoc) is a strong baseline that stays controllable.
name: TAPS
